In a sense, the whole universe is “a case of mistaken identity”, the fugitive undetectable becoming its own detective, on the hunt. Wrought in the human mind as plethora, the dance of evolutionary cohabitation makes a universe into a multiverse, a jostling and vying of many, with or against in some definite way. Each way of seeing, literally, makes a world unto its own. Indeed, this is undeniably the appearance. But we cannot afford to mistake the presentation with the presence, the countenance with the count, which, in the eye of wisdom, begins and ends at zero, and in the bosom of love, is a nestling one. What we account for with our spurious counting is the work of the Great Imagination, and we are right to revere the multiplying ways and walks, who each trace out the artistry of life in so many gaits and cadences as the pavings of time may allow. But what goes unaccounted in the vault of mind is the Artist, who is necessarily beyond the scope of the work, and yet, in the compelling radiance of each nested composition, shines through as the very essence of the art, inseparable from every immaculately inessential element, having poured with passion every ounce of its inherent inspiration to fructify its work with living beauty, such that you and I can live as an extension of its reality, if we so choose to know the Real. This Artist is monadic, and to the art the Artist is an aloof mystery, an invisibility sensed as the secret reality of the creation, but it is the One and only, despite the work; and this is because the work is nothing but its playful becoming. The urge to create cannot live without the seduction of destruction, for all artists know that there must always be a next piece, a new piecing together of the vision in situ. The artist will erase the piece, yet to it nothing is lost, nor could it ever be.
